coupling: The sample-width commit changes pipeline eligibility to choose the 16-bit RGB converter from the red plane alone; its runtime check still rejects narrower green or blue planes. The later layout-validation commit removes that runtime depth check while adding a layout check that verifies plane presence and dimensions but not sample widths. Either edit alone leaves a rejecting guard. Together a valid RGB image with 12-bit red and 8-bit green/blue enters the 16-bit converter, which reads two bytes per sample from an 8-bit plane. Repair requires reconciling the planner eligibility with the runtime plane-width contract across both commits.

pocs.entry_point: heif_decode_image via public uncompressed encode/read APIs
